title: Electron stability constrains neutrino time delays
summary: Superluminal neutrino propagation, induced by Lorentz-invariance violation (LIV), is strongly constrained by vacuum pair emission, $ν\to ν+ e^- + e^+$, a process ordinarily forbidden, which rapidly degrades the energy of high-energy neutrinos. Consequently, observable neutrino time delays are often preferentially associated with subluminal propagation, prompting LIV interpretations of claimed time delays between high-energy cosmic neutrinos and gamma rays.
